correctness.rationale: Petersen graphic matroid is connected, coloopless rank nine; known matroid independence complex shellability concentrates homology in degree eight and implies sphere wedge. The oriented, augmented Lefschetz trace for a permutation of its 15 graph edges is -sum_{union of full edge-orbits forest}(-1)^(number of selected orbits). I independently enumerated 32768 subsets (22292 forests) and all 120 induced S5 permutations with signed fixed-face parity. The exact trace distribution was identity 240 and zero for all 119 nonidentity elements, independently confirming the source orbit table; Q-rational character theory then gives two regular summands. Here exhaustive enumeration genuinely covers the finite Lefschetz sum, while shellability supplies the general homotopical step.

value.rationale: The Petersen graph is a canonical highly symmetric graphic matroid, but its ordinary top homology dimension does not determine its S5 module. Complete seven-class rational character and the surprising two-regular decomposition give a natural exact equivariant homological invariant useful in matroid symmetry comparisons. The nontrivial signed orbit cancellations, not generic matroid shellability, give its value.
